lyrics.ja: 好きになって！もっと！私を見て！もっと！
lyrics.romaji: Suki ni Natte! Motto! Watashi wo Mite! Motto!
lyrics.en: Fall for me! More! Look at me! More!
lyrics.zh: 喜歡上我吧！再多一點！看著我吧！再多一點！

lyrics.ja: 恩返しは「愛のこもった投げキッスで」
lyrics.romaji: Ongaeshi ha 「Ai no Komotta Nage Kissu de」
lyrics.en: I'll repay you with a loving flying kiss
lyrics.zh: 回報你就是「充滿愛意的飛吻」

lyrics.ja: 気のせいじゃない目は合ってるよ
lyrics.romaji: Ki no Sei ja Nai Me ha Atteru yo
lyrics.en: It's not your imagination—our eyes are meeting
lyrics.zh: 不是錯覺，我們四目相交了喔

lyrics.ja: ハート 作って恋しちゃって下さい！
lyrics.romaji: Haato Tsukutte Koishichatte Kudasai!
lyrics.en: Make a heart and fall in love with me, please!
lyrics.zh: 比個愛心，請愛上我吧！

lyrics.ja: やれること何でもします
lyrics.romaji: Yareru Koto Nandemo Shimasu
lyrics.en: I'll do anything I can
lyrics.zh: 什麼事我都願意做

lyrics.ja: NG無しで体当たり挑戦
lyrics.romaji: NG Nashi de Taiatari Chousen
lyrics.en: No restrictions—I'll throw myself into the challenge
lyrics.zh: 沒有禁忌，全力以赴地挑戰

lyrics.ja: エゴサで見つけたアンチのコメ
lyrics.romaji: Egosa de Mitsuketa Anchi no Kome
lyrics.en: Hater comments found while searching my own name
lyrics.zh: 搜自己名字時發現的黑粉留言

lyrics.ja: ふざけんな！誰より分かってるし
lyrics.romaji: Fuzaken na! Dare yori Wakatte Ru shi
lyrics.en: Don't mess with me! I know better than anyone
lyrics.zh: 少胡說！我比誰都清楚

lyrics.ja: でも大丈夫ステージに立てばみんながいる
lyrics.romaji: Demo Daijoubu Suteeji ni Tateba Minna ga Iru
lyrics.en: But it's okay—when I stand on stage, everyone's there
lyrics.zh: 但沒關係，只要站上舞台就有大家在

lyrics.ja: 好きになって！もっと！私を見て！もっと！
lyrics.romaji: Suki ni Natte! Motto! Watashi wo Mite! Motto
lyrics.en: Fall for me! More! Look at me! More!
lyrics.zh: 喜歡上我吧！再多一點！看著我吧！再多一點！

lyrics.ja: 恩返しは「愛のこもった投げキッスで」
lyrics.romaji: Ongaeshi ha 「Ai no Komotta Nage Kissu de」
lyrics.en: I'll repay you with a loving flying kiss
lyrics.zh: 回報你就是「充滿愛意的飛吻」

lyrics.ja: 虜にする！もっと！夢を見せる！もっと！
lyrics.romaji: Toriko ni Suru! Motto! Yume wo Miseru! Motto
lyrics.en: I'll captivate you! More! I'll show you dreams! More!
lyrics.zh: 讓你著迷！再多一點！讓你看見夢想！再多一點！

lyrics.ja: 楽しんでって 愛のこもったスペシャルナイト
lyrics.romaji: Tanoshinde tte Ai no Komotta Supesharu Naito
lyrics.en: Enjoy it—a special night full of love
lyrics.zh: 盡情享受，充滿愛意的特別夜晚

lyrics.ja: ファンサしちゃうぞ
lyrics.romaji: Fansa Shichau zo
lyrics.en: I'm gonna do some fan service
lyrics.zh: 我要來粉絲服務囉

lyrics.ja: お手紙も書いてください！
lyrics.romaji: Otegami mo Kaite Kudasai!
lyrics.en: Please write me letters too!
lyrics.zh: 也請寫信給我！

lyrics.ja: 何度も読んで宝物にします
lyrics.romaji: Nando mo Yonde Takaramono ni Shimasu
lyrics.en: I'll read them over and over and treasure them
lyrics.zh: 我會一讀再讀，當作寶物珍惜

lyrics.ja: スキャンダルまだ早いけど
lyrics.romaji: Sukyandaru Mada Hayai kedo
lyrics.en: It's too early for scandals
lyrics.zh: 雖然離緋聞還太早

lyrics.ja: 裏切りません！宣言しときます
lyrics.romaji: Uragirimasen! Sengen Shitokimasu
lyrics.en: I won't betray you! Let me declare it now
lyrics.zh: 我不會背叛！先在此宣言

lyrics.ja: 嫉妬、嫌がらせには負けない
lyrics.romaji: Shitto, Iyagarase ni ha Makenai
lyrics.en: I won't lose to jealousy or harassment
lyrics.zh: 不會輸給嫉妒和騷擾

lyrics.ja: ふざけんな！実力で勝ってやる
lyrics.romaji: Fuzaken na! Jitsuryoku de Katte Yaru
lyrics.en: Don't mess with me! I'll win with my skills
lyrics.zh: 少胡說！我會用實力取勝

lyrics.ja: だから辞めない負けず嫌い私はいる（行くよ！）
lyrics.romaji: Dakara Yamenai Makezugirai Watashi ha Iru (Iku yo!)
lyrics.en: So here I am, hating to lose, and I won't quit (Let's go!)
lyrics.zh: 所以不服輸的我才不會放棄（要上囉！）

lyrics.ja: こぶし上げて！もっと！汗をかいて！もっと！
lyrics.romaji: Kobushi Agete! Motto! Ase wo Kaite! Motto!
lyrics.en: Raise your fists! More! Sweat it out! More!
lyrics.zh: 舉起拳頭！再多一點！揮灑汗水！再多一點！

lyrics.ja: 恩返しは「愛のこもったそらビームで」（フ～！！）
lyrics.romaji: Ongaeshi ha 「Ai no Komotta Mona Biimu de」 (Fuu!)
lyrics.en: I'll repay you with a loving Sora beam (Woo!)
lyrics.zh: 回報你就是「充滿愛意的Sora光束」（呼！）

lyrics.ja: 大歓声！もっと！まだまだ！ねえ？もっと！
lyrics.romaji: Daikansei! Motto! Mada Mada! Nee? Motto!
lyrics.en: Big cheers! More! Not yet! Hey? More!
lyrics.zh: 大聲歡呼！再多一點！還不夠！吶？再多一點！

lyrics.ja: 受け止めてね 愛のこもったわがままソング
lyrics.romaji: Uketomete ne Ai no Komotta Wagamama Songu
lyrics.en: Catch it, please—this selfish song full of love
lyrics.zh: 接住這首充滿愛意的任性之歌吧

lyrics.ja: ファンサしちゃうぞ
lyrics.romaji: Fansa Shichau zo
lyrics.en: I'm gonna do some fan service
lyrics.zh: 我要來粉絲服務囉

lyrics.ja: はぁ 終わりが近づく
lyrics.romaji: Haa Owari ga Chikazuku
lyrics.en: Sigh, the end is approaching
lyrics.zh: 唉，尾聲將近

lyrics.ja: 寂しいね
lyrics.romaji: Sabishii ne
lyrics.en: It's sad, isn't it?
lyrics.zh: 好寂寞呢

lyrics.ja: 楽しいのに泣きそうだよ
lyrics.romaji: Tanoshii no ni Nakisou Da yo
lyrics.en: Even though it's fun, I feel like crying
lyrics.zh: 明明很開心卻快要哭了

lyrics.ja: 次も次もまた会えるよね？（約束！）
lyrics.romaji: Tsugi mo Tsugi mo Mata Aeru yo ne? (Yakusoku!)
lyrics.en: We'll meet again next time and the time after, right? (Promise!)
lyrics.zh: 下次還有下下次還能再見面吧？（約好了！）

lyrics.ja: 優しさに溢れている言葉も
lyrics.romaji: Yasashisa ni Afurete Iru Kotoba mo
lyrics.en: Words overflowing with kindness
lyrics.zh: 充滿溫柔的話語

lyrics.ja: 心ない誰かの言葉さえも
lyrics.romaji: Kokoro Nai Dareka no Kotoba Sae mo
lyrics.en: And even the thoughtless words of some people
lyrics.zh: 甚至是某些人無心的話語

lyrics.ja: 必要なんだ必要なんだ
lyrics.romaji: Hitsuyou na n Da Hitsuyou na n Da
lyrics.en: I need them, I need them
lyrics.zh: 都是必要的，都是必要的

lyrics.ja: 強くなろう
lyrics.romaji: Tsuyoku Narou
lyrics.en: Let's become stronger
lyrics.zh: 變得更堅強吧

lyrics.ja: 好きに叫べ！もっと！楽しんじゃえ！もっと！
lyrics.romaji: Suki ni Sakebe! Motto! Tanoshinjae! Motto!
lyrics.en: Shout freely! More! Enjoy it all! More!
lyrics.zh: 盡情吶喊！再多一點！盡情享受！再多一點！

lyrics.ja: 忘れないで 特別な日になりますように
lyrics.romaji: Wasrenaide Tokubetsu na Hi ni Narimasu You ni
lyrics.en: Don't forget—may this become a special day
lyrics.zh: 別忘記，願這成為特別的一天

lyrics.ja: 共に歌おうずっと！共に歩もうずっと！
lyrics.romaji: Tomo ni Utaou Zutto! Tomo ni Ayumou Zutto!
lyrics.en: Let's sing together forever! Let's walk together forever!
lyrics.zh: 一起歌唱到永遠！一起前行到永遠！

lyrics.ja: 合言葉はとびっきりのL-O-V-E
lyrics.romaji: Aikotoba ha Tobikkiri no L-O-V-E
lyrics.en: The password is the greatest L-O-V-E
lyrics.zh: 通關密語是最棒的L-O-V-E
